cards.title: The compare chart-to verb (metric to comparator)

aliases.name: morphing the P/E to a more visual number

cards.does: The figure the market quotes becomes the number the viewer feels: the metric's own outlines - measured off the page's ink - sag and BALL UP at its datum, and the ball becomes the comparator's glyphs (or bursts, or is thrown).

author.example: {"kind": "chart_to", "at": 32.0, "dur": 1.2, "to": "compare", "metric": {"value": 24.8, "text": "24.8x", "label": "forward P/E"}, "comparator": {"value": 0.1535, "text": "15 % dearer", "label": "dearer than its own history"}, "inputs": {"pe": 24.8, "hist": 21.5}, "derive": "pe / hist - 1", "source": "[DERIVED: from ev-meta-pe-v1 + the 10-year median, pe / hist - 1]"}

phases.name: the ink sags
phases.does: `form: melt` (the default): the figure's own glyph outlines - measured off the page's ink by kinetics/contour.mjs - sag on melt.mjs's law, the top sinking and the foot hanging in seeded drips

phases.name: the ink balls up
phases.does: every outline is carried by morph_a into ONE disc that holds the ink's own area (never MELT.BALL_R, a share of a PAGE's height), on melt's stepped clock: the number compiles into a heavy ball

phases.name: the ball becomes the comparator
phases.does: `then: morph` (the default): the ball's one ring is carried into the comparator's glyph rings by the pairing rule - by rank on centroid x, surplus rings born from the ball's own centre

phases.name: the ball bursts or is thrown
phases.does: `then: splash`: melt.mjs's seeded splatter at the figure's scale, drying as the hand writes. `then: throw`: the ball sits in its weight and is thrown off, the hand writing after melt's release

phases.name: the quoted figure is taken away
phases.does: `form: streak` (P57 T12b): the glyphs melt where they stand, each a drip opening in the hand's reading order on melt's run. `form: collapse`: the hand takes the ink back, last glyph first

phases.name: the hand re-writes the comparator
phases.does: on every form but the morph, the comparator's `text` is written at the SAME DATUM by the figure's own hand (species/figure.mjs's write clock), glyph after glyph
phases.trigger: TAKE_SHARE of `dur` (streak, collapse), the ending's own release (splash, throw)

phases.name: the numeral counts
phases.does: `form: count` (E60's counter, the form P57 T12 shipped): the quoted numeral runs to the comparator's on min-jerk, in the metric's own clothes

phases.name: the words cross
phases.does: `form: count`: the text either side of the numeral crosses THROUGH ZERO - the metric's clothes become the comparator's where there is nothing on screen to swap
phases.trigger: SWAP of `dur`, over CROSS of it

phases.name: the label is written
phases.does: the comparator's `label` - what the number MEANS - is written beneath by the hand

phases.name: the metric holds beside it
phases.does: `hold: "metric"` stands the quoted figure beside the comparator at GHOST_A of the ink and GHOST_F of the size; `hold: "gone"` gives the comparator the stage

options.means: form: THE DEFAULT - the quoted figure's outlines sag on melt.mjs's law and BALL UP into one disc that holds the ink's own area; `then` says what becomes of the ball
form: P57 T12b's text melt - the glyphs drip where they stand under melt's words streak, then the hand re-writes the comparator
form: the hand takes the quoted figure's ink back first (the undraw law), then re-writes the comparator
form: E60's counter - the numeral counts to the comparator's and the words cross through zero (P57 T12's form, kept as a setting)
then: THE DEFAULT - the ball's one ring is carried by morph_a into the comparator's glyph rings (one ring into N), and the figure's <text> takes over at u = 1
then: the ball bursts onto the page (melt.mjs's seeded splatter) and the hand writes the comparator through the drying ink
then: the ball sits in its own weight and is thrown off the page (melt.mjs's flight), and the hand writes the comparator after it
hold: the quoted metric stays legible beside the comparator (the default)
hold: the quoted metric leaves and the comparator has the stage

lives.note: species/compare.mjs on PAGE_PAINTERS.compare, after the figures it morphs. P57 T12c (E76 s5): the default is composed from contour.mjs, morph_a.mjs, melt.mjs and figure.mjs

cards.title: The extend chart-to verb
cards.does: New points or a later series draw on at the pen after the axes retarget.

phases.name: axes retarget
phases.does: the axes rescale to the grown window first

phases.name: pen draws on
phases.does: the new points draw on at the pen

cards.title: The morph-to chart-to verb (ARAP)
cards.does: The area under one line becomes another line's area mid-page by as-rigid-as-possible morphing.

phases.name: line leaves
phases.does: the standing line leaves

phases.name: area morphs
phases.does: the area under the line becomes the target's by ARAP

phases.name: target builds
phases.does: the target line builds over the morphed area

cards.title: The park chart-to verb
cards.does: The chart shrinks toward a corner of its own box to make room, and grows back on an un-park.

phases.name: park
phases.does: the active chart shrinks toward its anchor corner on min-jerk and holds

phases.name: un-park
phases.does: a later park to scale 1.0 grows it back
phases.trigger: a later chart_to park with scale 1.0

cards.title: The recast chart-to verb

aliases.name: `recast` keyed: n lines become n bars

cards.does: The same data changes form on the page - lines become bars by series, by tag, by data, or by a hand-over.

phases.name: words erase
phases.does: the standing sub and source erase

phases.name: standing chart leaves
phases.does: plain: the chart un-draws on segEase while its axes hand over; keyed: marks tween (tags appear over KEYED.TAG first); data-keyed: the data travel to their bars on a clock of at least MIN_S

phases.name: new words write
phases.does: the arriving state's sub and source write

phases.name: target builds
phases.does: plain recast: the named state draws on by its own build envelope

lives.note: lpPaintStates / plain hand-over + keyed branch (lpPaintRecastKeyed / lpPaintRecastData) + kinetics/chartxf.mjs

cards.title: The whole-chart remake
cards.does: A full chart becomes a full chart on one clock: every series, datum, axis, label and the title transform, line <-> bars.

phases.name: the history leaves
phases.does: the dash window slides from the line's start to the first keyed datum; the bars page's own numbers un-write

phases.name: the ink drops into the columns
phases.does: each keyed datum's share of the source's ink fills as the stroke over it leaves

phases.name: the shapes travel
phases.does: every ring morphs into its counterpart by morph_a, the datum marks travel to their bars' tops, the axes hand over and the labels re-write

phases.name: the target's own ink takes over
phases.does: a bars target's rectangles take the landed rings' place and their numbers write; a line target strokes along the landed top edge while the fill leaves with it

blends.source: E99 s34 a morph reads as a transformation, not a cut
E64 the data-keyed recast (the datum travels, the axes hand over)

lives.note: lpPaintRemake (+ kinetics/chartxf.mjs's rings and clock, kinetics/morph_a.mjs's pairing)

cards.title: The rescale chart-to verb
cards.does: The chart's axes retarget on one clock to the window the story is about.

phases.name: marks re-project
phases.does: every mark moves from its place under scale A to its place under B on one eased clock

phases.name: old ticks leave
phases.does: ticks outside the new domain fade out by half the clock

phases.name: new ticks arrive
phases.does: ticks of the new domain fade in over the second half
